operation_details.item: The original revenue forecast assumed 15% growth.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! I’m reviewing the revenue section of the board pack today. The forecast has been updated to 12% growth.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning. Yes, I saw that revision. The original forecast assumed 15% growth, but the enterprise pipeline has been moving more slowly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. The slower pipeline is a solid rationale for using the more measured assumption.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Agreed. I’ve updated the supporting budget analysis to align with the 12% forecast.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. I’ll use the updated figures when checking the planning scenarios and margin sensitivities.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. The revised forecast and explanation are both in the board pack now.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original 15% growth assumption and retain the current 12% forecast and its rationale.
